# API conventions

- Wrap with `withAuth(withErrorHandler(handler as any))` from `@/lib/auth` — provides user + company + transaction GUCs.
- Compose `withRole(...)` inside `withAuth` for role gates.
- Use `withUserAuth` for pure JWT-verify (no company scope).
- Legacy `withCompany` is removed (GoTrue cutover) — do NOT use it.
- Response helpers: `apiResponse.success / badRequest / notFound / methodNotAllowed` from `@/lib/apiResponse`.
- Every query in handlers MUST scope by `company_id` and use `sql` tagged template from `@/lib/neon`.
- No `console.log` — use `log` from `@/lib/logger`.
